rows.title: Permissionless public pipeline
rows.note: K lacks a permissionless public pipeline and any membership decision for a project, registry, council, Foreman, or hosted service.

rows.title: One semantic relation
rows.note: K lacks one versioned relation binding program, profile, signed intention, current authority, history, observations, complete effects, costs, and residual duties.

rows.title: Native target and correspondence
rows.note: K lacks valid-execution completeness and adversarial-witness soundness for a pinned ZKIRv3 or qualified successor target.

rows.title: Intent and solver completion
rows.note: K lacks solver completion that preserves signed choices, gross caps, fees, net outcomes, liabilities, disclosures, and recovery.

rows.title: Complete financial state

evidence.quote: Financial admission and state transitions execute in K; the codec does not evaluate the financial result.
The four-step loan lifecycle runs Originate, Accrue, partial Repay and final Repay, carrying each actual K result into the next call.

rows.note: Covers: lcTransfer, lcOriginate, lcAccrue, and lcRepay update balances, allowances, obligations, and ordered effects; Missing: separate authorized supply, fees, and residual duties over an authenticated complete state domain.

rows.title: Phases and partiality
rows.note: K lacks signed phase-specific retained effects, fees, authority consumption, and remaining duties after failure.

rows.title: Conditional settlement
rows.note: K lacks conditional settlement that separates request recording, funding, eligibility, in-flight effects, and actual delivery.

rows.title: Recovery and state limits
rows.note: K lacks recovery or successor transitions that preserve consent, cumulative budgets, replay state, and duties at expiry, work, or state limits.

rows.title: Full history scope
rows.note: K lacks authenticated origin, compatible well-founded predecessors, and native recursive or private split/join history.

rows.title: Privacy and completeness
rows.note: K lacks a private continuation that binds an authenticated completeness domain, permitted observations, and a witness handoff.

rows.title: Federation and adapter boundary
rows.note: K lacks an external adapter that binds decoded bytes and effects to one intention, stage, domain, epoch, and evidence policy.

rows.title: Delegated AI spending
rows.note: K lacks delegated spending with attenuated owner authority and durable aggregate spent, pending, and reserved budgets.

rows.title: Service lifecycle
rows.note: K lacks a service lifecycle that preserves logical request identity across payment finality, result availability, and recipient delivery.

rows.title: Semantic evolution
rows.note: K lacks evolution of program, verifier, policy, federation epoch, or persistent state with preserved obligations or amendment consent.

rows.title: Assurance and release
rows.note: K lacks release rows that separate specified, inspected, tested, proved-under-assumptions, locally accepted, and Preview-finalized evidence.

rows.title: Next native backend contract
rows.note: K lacks the next native backend contract for ZR01-ZR16 and MNR01-MNR08, including native recursive financial history and private multi-parent composition.

rows.title: stage
